name: Anathema's End loads into an unloaded Gun weapon
notes: Anathema's End is an UMBRA (advanced element) ITEM card, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real UMBRA champion (Tristan, Shadowdancer) to unlock element access. Framework Sidearm (a REGALIA,WEAPON with the GUN subtype and no Subcards, i.e. unloaded) is seeded onto the field as the [REST] Load ability's target, same pattern and target-resolution mechanism (LoadBulletIntoGun) as penetrator-round-load-gun. Only the always-available Load half is covered; the [Class Bonus] On Champion Hit curse-banishing trigger requires a real combat hit and is out of scope.

rulesClauses: [REST]: Load CARDNAME into target unloaded Gun weapon you control.
